content: Plan: Strat/CombDeriv.lean (namespace Thermite.Strat.Cls) — eight comb_deriv_* lemmas over REQ-3 structural fdenote (q:Atom->Bool, dom:List Tm). Six bounded combinators (forall_in/exists_in/sorted/forall_below/forall_from/disjoint) get genuine raw-quantifier Cls.Frm expansions (read/len/rel/app1); each comb_deriv proves fdenote(expansion)=true <-> bounded forall/exists characterization over dom (the v1 verus_l3 shape modulo q; atom-grounding stays REQ-8 per option B). Two census combinators count_where/permutation_of demote to DEFINITIONAL forms (filter-length fold; per-element count multiset-eq). PinCombDeriv: off-by-one (le vs lt) refuted by decide. Register via scripts/lean-axiom-probe.sh build targets + in-file print axioms.
